book.title: Write the Book Title Here
book.author: Author Name
book.shortIntroduction: This is placeholder text. Replace it with your own introduction: why you chose this book and what draws you into its world.

introduction: This is placeholder text and contains no factual claims about a real book.
Use this section to introduce the author, the context in which the work emerged, and why you chose to read it. Write or approve the final text yourself.
summary: Write a spoiler-free summary here. Avoid revealing the ending, major twists, or details that could undermine the reading experience.
perspective: Placeholder: write your own personal response here. The template never invents an opinion on your behalf.
analysis: Placeholder: discuss structure, ideas, strengths, weaknesses, and narrative or argumentative technique using specific examples.

content: Spoiler placeholder: add your own discussion of the ending or a major reveal after reading the book. This is not a factual description of any book.

notes.title: Sample note
notes.text: Placeholder card. Replace it with an actual observation or idea from your reading.

notes.title: A question to revisit
notes.text: What deserves a closer look after finishing the book?

quotes.text: Insert an exact quotation from your own edition here.
quotes.commentary: This is a placeholder, not a real quotation.

context: Add relevant historical, cultural, or intellectual context with credible sources. If it does not apply, disable this section in visibility.

research.question: How can this question be investigated using reliable sources?
research.explanation: Briefly explain why the question matters.
